name: WP Obituary Manager
author: Arni Cinco

sections.description:
View Demo

WP Obituary Manager provides a simple way to manage obituaries and condolences directly from your WordPress admin dashboard.

Designed for funeral service providers, it allows you to:
– Create and manage obituaries
– Accept and moderate visitor condolences
– Customize layouts and display options
– Easily integrate obituaries into your website

Developed by WPTaskforce.com, a web design agency based in Iloilo City, Philippines.

✨ Features at a Glance

  • ✅ Custom Obituary Post Type – Manage obituaries like regular WordPress posts.
  • ✅ Frontend Submission Form – Allow families or staff to submit obituaries online.
  • ✅ Obituary Slider Shortcode – Showcase recent obituaries anywhere on your site.
  • ✅ Condolence Management – Visitors can leave condolences; admins can moderate.
  • ✅ Print-Friendly Obituary Pages – Works seamlessly with popular WordPress PDF/print plugins for downloadable or printable obituaries.
  • ✅ Elementor Support – Works seamlessly with Elementor page builder.
  • ✅ Customizable Settings – Set default thumbnails and obituary layouts.

💡 Need to migrate existing obituaries? Contact us for import services.
📩 Reach us on Microsoft Teams: arni.cinco@outlook.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload WP_Obituary.zip to /wp-content/plugins/, or search WP Obituary Manager in your WordPress dashboard under Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu.
  3. Configure settings: go to Obituaries → Settings to set your default thumbnail and layout.
  4. Visit your obituary page at www.yourdomain.com/obituaries.
sections.faq:
How can I add an obituary?

You can add one in the WordPress dashboard under Obituaries, or allow visitors to submit via the frontend form.

Where is my obituary page?

By default, it’s available at: www.yourdomain.com/obituaries.

How are condolences managed?

Condolences are stored as comments and can be moderated via the WordPress admin dashboard.
